description: Source code for UE (User Equipment) configuration procedures in a 3GPP 5G NR network, including resource management, bearer setup, reconfiguration, and handover handling.

classes.name: ue_configuration_procedure
classes.description: Handles UE configuration, resource allocation, bearer management, and reconfiguration procedures.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Main execution method for UE configuration procedure, managing the sequence of configuration steps.

methods.name: stop_drbs_to_rem
methods.description: Stops traffic on DRBs scheduled for removal.

methods.name: update_ue_context
methods.description: Creates and updates UE bearers, including SRBs and DRBs, and manages their connections.

methods.name: clear_old_ue_context
methods.description: Removes old DRB contexts from the UE executor.

methods.name: update_mac_and_sched
methods.description: Reconfigures MAC layer and scheduler for the UE.

methods.name: make_ue_config_response
methods.description: Constructs a successful UE context update response with configured DRBs.

methods.name: make_ue_config_failure
methods.description: Constructs a failure response for UE configuration.

methods.name: changed_detected
methods.description: Checks if there are any configuration changes to process.

methods.name: handle_conditional_mobility_request
methods.description: Processes conditional mobility (handover) requests if present.

methods.name: handle_rrc_reconfiguration_complete_ind
methods.description: Handles RRC reconfiguration completion indication, flushing buffers as needed.
